title: Cops Bust Woman’s Elaborate Target Scam
description:
On August 9th, 2024, officers were dispatched to Target in response to an ongoing shoplifting incident. The loss prevention officer informed them that a woman was replacing price tags on items with cheaper tags. She was caught on CCTV footage committing the crime. She then proceeded to the self-checkout, where she scanned only 5 of the 12 items, totaling $19.50, though the actual cost should have been $268.48. As she was leaving without paying for the other 7 items, an employee stopped her and called the police. The officer tried to understand how the woman was replacing the tags. The female officer attempted to motivate her child, who was afraid of the bullies, to go to school. Soon, the child’s grandfather arrived to take him home. They tried to understand why the woman was stealing in the first place. Based on the evidence collected by the officers, the woman was arrested. The woman was previously caught stealing from Target on December 23, but the store didn’t pursue charges. This time, she was charged with shoplifting items worth $100 to $749 and with scheming to defraud under $749.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
